body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, impose -2 on its next Success Die until the start of your next turn. You may move 1 unit after resolving.

surges.html: After a hit, the target becomes Exposed until the start of your next turn.
An ally within 3 units gains +1 to the targeted Defense against that enemy's next attack until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Contingency - Reversal
rider.html: When this target declares an Action against you before your next turn, you may swap places with an adjacent willing ally; that ally chooses whether to become the legal target instead.
